title: Modules and Fields | Layout builder Save doesn't persist field changes (validation regex, Mark as Unique)
env: staging-crm.taviportal.com · tenant NDC-Staging · Edge (headless) + API · mahmoud.mahamed1515 (CRM Admin); test users 1/2, automation where noted

panels.caption: After Save + reload: QA phone field keeps the regex ^01[0125]\d{8}$.
QA email field after Mark as Unique + Mark as Required: required (*).

rows: PUT field 200 with the regex; after reload editor and API show ^01[0125]\d{8}$
PATCH constraints {required:true, unique:true} 200; API unique = true, required = true
phone 123 → 422 "does not match the required pattern"; 01012345678 → 201
duplicate email → 422 "already in use"; no email → 422 "is required"
QA email set back to not required right after (module-wide setting)
Tested on QA fields of a QA layout; an earlier capture with the regex missing "\" was our tooling, not the app
